hook: Can you believe IdeaAnchor reads multiple papers to generate novel research?

sections.voiceover: Can you believe IdeaAnchor reads multiple papers to generate novel research?
b_roll: A digital interface displaying academic papers.

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, researchers like Ziyu Chen introduced IdeaAnchor. IdeaAnchor fixes how prompting lacks structured supervision for synthesis. How does IdeaAnchor build new ideas from multiple papers?
b_roll: Portrait of researchers working in a university lab.
A complex network diagram connecting multiple research documents.

sections.voiceover: Standard models rely on basic feedback, but IdeaAnchor utilizes structured specifications.
b_roll: Code scrolling on a dark monitor screen.

sections.voiceover: Ziyu Chen mined published papers to supervise large language models. IdeaAnchor successfully builds novel ideation out of input research documents.
b_roll: A glowing neural network processing text files.
A split screen showing papers transforming into structured data.

sections.voiceover: Read the arXiv paper to explore IdeaAnchor today.
b_roll: An open browser window displaying an academic preprint.
